## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link an issue when relevant.

## Validation

List the commands, results and exact simulator/machine scope. Distinguish unit
tests, database tests, browser checks and physical-machine acceptance.

- [ ] Relevant tests, shared contracts and documentation are updated.
- [ ] Migrations preserve existing data and were checked on a fresh database.
- [ ] No credentials, customer data, private keys or generated files are included.
- [ ] Support and safety claims match the available evidence.
